segments.englishExplanation: Stating that it is late in the day.
Noting that the sun has set and nighttime has arrived.

segments.text: Can I play five more minutes?
segments.englishExplanation: Asking for permission to keep playing for a brief extra amount of time.

segments.text: No, it is against the rules to stay out. We go home. Okay.
segments.englishExplanation: Denying permission because staying outside violates the rules, and insisting on leaving for home.
segments.turkishExplanation: Hayır, dışarıda kalmak kurallara aykırı. Eve gidiyoruz. Tamam mı?

segments.englishExplanation: A polite fixed phrase for saying "no" and confirming the refusal: "I'm afraid not" softens a negative answer.
segments.turkishExplanation: Reddi kibarca pekiştiren kalıp: "I'm afraid not" = "Korkarım olmaz", "hayır"ı yumuşatır.

segments.englishExplanation: Reluctantly accepting the decision to leave.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to describe an action that is not permitted by an established guideline, regulation, or law.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Belirlenmiş bir kurala, talimata veya yasaya aykırı olan durumları ifade etmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Using your phone during the exam is against the rules.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Sınav sırasında telefon kullanmak kurallara aykırıdır.

quiz.question: In segment 4, why can't the boy keep playing in the park?

options.text: Staying out after dark is not allowed.
The park closes at noon every day.
He has not finished his homework.
His friends have already gone home.
